title: Skill credit auction and minimum-slate protocol
creator: Priya Natarajan
description: Create and pilot a lightweight operational mechanism for reallocating scarce specialist time mid-cycle using transferable 'skill credits' and a weekly internal auction to surface tradeoffs and enable targeted scope swaps without across-the-board decommits.
objectives: Reduce firefighting-driven unplanned de-scopes by providing a transparent in-cycle market for short-term specialist allocation
Capture data to evaluate whether credit-based reallocation reduces cycle slippage vs ad-hoc escalation
Provide an auditable, low-friction process that PMs and Eng leads can use to request / provide capacity for critical path work
acceptance_criteria: Pilot run for 4 weekly auctions with at least 6 participating teams
Automated dashboard shows credit bids, awarded swaps, and resulting scope movement within 48 hours of auction close
Leadership sign-off endorses continuation if median awarded-swap leads to <= 1 week schedule slip vs baseline
All trades are recorded and have clear owner handoffs and post-swap check-ins scheduled
rollout_plan: Week 0: PRD + playbook finalization; confirm sponsor (VP Product) and 6 participating squads
Week 1: Training session for PM/EM leads + set up auction sheet and dashboard (Datadog/Looker-lite)
Week 2-5: Run weekly auctions; Product team facilitates; observe and collect metrics
Week 6: Retrospective and decision: iterate, stop, or scale to broader org
metrics: Number of auction bids per round
Percent of winning bids that result in delivered scope by original owner within agreed window
Median schedule impact (days) on both donor and receiver tickets
Pct of auctions that avoid org-level de-scopes requested by Engineering leadership
decision_log: 2026-03-02: Decided to cap transferable credits per team to 3/week to avoid concentration risk
2026-03-05: Opted for weekly auctions (vs ad-hoc) to maximize visibility and allow planning cadence
2026-03-08: Chose non-monetary priority weighting (team reputation score) in tie-breaker to prevent gaming with trivial trades
risks_mitigation: Risk: Teams hoard credits -> Mitigation: weekly credit decay (unused credits drop by 1 after 2 weeks)
Risk: Critical feature starvation if donors are over-indexed -> Mitigation: donor must nominate minimum-slate items that cannot be taken (3 items/weekly slate)
Risk: Perception of unfairness -> Mitigation: transparent public audit log and bi-weekly sponsor review
notes: Prototype artifacts: auction spreadsheet template in Drive (drive.google.com/drive/fake-link-auction-template)
Dashboard: Looker-lite board id 1325 (internal) will be used for live metrics
Approx implementation effort: minimal tooling (Google Sheet + Slackbot announcement) + small dashboard embed (~2 engineer-days)
Key stakeholders: VP Product (sponsor), Eng Productivity (ops), 6 pilot squad leads
